biotools.summary: Integrated Meta-omic Pipeline, version 3: a reproducible Snakemake workflow for the integrated analysis of metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data — preprocessing, hybrid assembly, annotation, read-based taxonomy, binning into MAGs (CheckM2, GTDB-Tk) and per-sample statistics. Runs on metagenomes or metatranscriptomes alone, too.
